exposure: Natural language processing of clinician documentation
cohort: Individuals admitted for delivery at Brigham and Women's Hospital, Boston, Massachusetts, between July 1, 2016, and February 29, 2020.
finding: The natural language processing (NLP) method demonstrated a predictive performance for severe maternal morbidity (SMM) that was comparable to a previously validated risk-stratification tool, the Obstetric Comorbidity Index (OB-CMI).
